name: Video-Bench_videos
description:
Video-Bench is a benchmark tool designed to systematically leverage MLLMs across all dimensions relevant to video generation assessment in generative models. By incorporating few-shot scoring and chain-of-query techniques, Video-Bench provides a structured, scalable approach to generating video evaluation.
More details in the paper.
evaluation_method: human_eval (MLLM-assisted scoring / few-shot automated scorers), often combined into composite quality/ranking scores
reputation: An emerging evaluation suite for video-generation and MLLM-based video assessment used by some research groups but not yet a widely standardized benchmark.
